name: Winterfall Runners
label: Quest
description: Winterfall Runners: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When this toxic substance is mixed with the water from the hot springs, it loses its toxicity, only retaining the ability to temporarily affect those that ingest it. This must be why the Winterfall protect the hot springs so fervently -- they need them to purify their firewater.

We need to stop this -- cut off contact between the Winterfall and the Deadwood. A group of runners walks the distance between their village and Felwood. Find and defeat them, and steal their shipment.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We'll see what happens when the Winterfall don't get their firewater!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wonder if consuming this substance makes the furbolg more aggressive. They do seem much larger...
